verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so snoozing and follow-up reminders are a fair axis to judge it on. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions snooze, reminders, or resurfacing threads that get no reply. The documented features cover labels, archive and delete, drafts, read/unread status, AI compose and search, none of which delivers this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies
